integrity: Analytic proof and exact finite enumeration are provided. Finite checks are not infinite proof. Independent external audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform perfect pairing of strictly ordered distinct endpoints; \(n\ge2\); random geometry independent of matching and integrable range. Only covariance sign, not negative association. Potential historical implicit equivalences not completely excluded.
title: Negative component–coverage covariance for uniformly paired intervals
